title: SAM 3D Animal: Promptable Animal 3D Reconstruction from Images in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2605.07604v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: 3D animal reconstruction in the wild remains challenging due to large species variation, frequent occlusions, and the prevalence of multi-animal scenes, while existing methods predominantly focus on single-animal settings. We present SAM 3D Animal, the first promptable framework for multi-animal 3D reconstruction from a single image. Built on the SMAL+ parametric animal model, our method jointly reconstructs multiple instances and supports flexible prompts in the form of keypoints and masks which enable more reliable disambiguation in crowded and occluded scenes. To train such a model, we further introduce Herd3D, a multi-animal 3D dataset containing over 5K images, designed to increase diversity in species, interactions, and occlusion patterns. translated_title: SAM 3D Animal：面向野外图像的可提示动物3D重建
translated_abstract: 野外的3D动物重建仍然充满挑战，原因在于物种间差异巨大、遮挡频繁发生以及多动物场景的普遍存在，而现有方法主要局限于单动物设置。我们提出了SAM 3D Animal，这是首个支持可提示方式的、从单张图像进行多动物3D重建的框架。该方法基于SMAL+参数化动物模型构建，能够联合重建多个实例，并支持以关键点和掩码形式提供的灵活提示，从而在拥挤和遮挡场景中实现更可靠的歧义消除。为了训练这样的模型，我们进一步引入了Herd3D，这是一个包含超过5000张图像的多动物3D数据集，旨在提升物种、互动和遮挡模式方面的多样性。在Animal3D、APTv2和Animal Kingdom数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架在现有基于模型和无模型的方法中均取得了最先进的结果。
tldr: SAM 3D Animal是首个从单张图像进行可提示多动物3D重建的框架，通过SMAL+参数模型、关键点与掩码提示以及新提出的Herd3D多动物数据集，在野外物种多样、遮挡严重和多动物场景下实现了最先进的重建效果。
en_tdlr: SAM 3D Animal is the first promptable framework for multi-animal 3D reconstruction from a single image, leveraging the SMAL+ parametric model, keypoint and mask prompts, and a newly introduced Herd3D dataset to achieve state-of-the-art results in challenging in-the-wild scenes with diverse species, occlusions, and multiple animals.
